item.summy-reliquary-apocrypha.new_testa: Where the arrows fall, grace follows.
On hit, {value|%s%} chance to spawn {value|%s}~{value|%s} {arrow|falling arrows} at 0~{value|%s}° from {value|%s} blocks above the target's head
{arrow|Falling arrows} deal {value|%s} true damage and ignore invulnerability frames
item.summy-reliquary-apocrypha.swift_fea: "They shall mount up with wings as eagles."
With the New Testament, the arrows fall on swift wings.
{arrow|Falling arrow} damage becomes {value|%s%} of the triggering arrow
item.summy-reliquary-apocrypha.wing_feat: "Your arrows shall be as wings, bringing down bread from heaven."
As the New Testament heals you, light feathers gather behind your back.
New Testament healing triggers grant +1 {feather|light feather}
At 3 or more {feather|light feathers} a pair of {feather|wings} unfolds behind the wearer
At {feather|light feather} 4, shooting spends 1 and turns that arrow into a {sacrament|Sacrament Arrow}
Out of combat, one {feather|light feather} pair fades every {value|%s} s after {value|%s} s
item.summy-reliquary-apocrypha.inverse_f: "He makes me lie down in green pastures, He leads me beside still waters."
Wings grown against the wind, slowing every fall.
Hold sneak in midair to slow the descent by {value|−%s%}
item.summy-reliquary-apocrypha.paired_wi: "Can two walk together, except they be agreed?"
Wings that beat as one reach the same mark.
Arrow hits have a {value|%s%} chance to summon an extra {holy|holy arrow}
{holy|Holy arrows} deal {value|%s%} of the triggering arrow as true damage
{holy|Holy arrows} fly at full-charge arrow speed, ignore gravity, pierce entities without limit and are stopped by blocks
While worn together with the New Testament:
Either trigger pulls in the other after 0.1 s
If falling arrows and a {holy|holy arrow} trigger together, {holy|holy arrow} +1 and falling arrows +1
death.attack.summy-reliquary-apocrypha.h: %1$s was pierced by a holy arrow
death.attack.summy-reliquary-apocrypha.a: %1$s was consumed by apoptotic elemental damage
item.summy-reliquary-apocrypha.fallen_he: "I beheld Satan as lightning fall from heaven."
Wings burned to ash; nothing left but the fall.
Melee hits stack 1 stack of {apoptosis|Apoptosis Damage} on the target
At {value|%s} stacks the {apoptosis|Apoptosis Damage} {burst|bursts} for {value|%s} {element|elemental damage}
The target then enters a {value|%s} s {state|Injured} state: incoming damage adds {value|%s%} {element|elemental damage} and healing is cut by {value|%s%}
After the {state|Injured} state it gains {resist|Apoptosis Resist} for {value|%s} s
Neither the {state|Injured} state nor {resist|Apoptosis Resist} stacks damage
{element|Elemental damage} is a special true damage that takes no damage bonuses
item.summy-reliquary-apocrypha.fallen_pl: "Where the feathers fall, only ash remains."
Every fallen feather remembers one descent.
{burst|Burst} damage becomes the sum of the hits that stacked the {apoptosis|Apoptosis Damage} x{value|%s%}
Elemental bonus damage during the {state|Injured} state rises to {value|%s%}
A pair of wings unfolds for {value|%s} s when it bursts, refreshed on every burst
item.summy-reliquary-apocrypha.scourged_: "Only under the lash is the heart seen plain."
Every beat counts the strokes it has taken.
If the target is at or below {value|%s%} health it takes extra {element|elemental damage} equal to {value|%s%} of its max health
item.summy-reliquary-apocrypha.withered_: "Only when the ink runs dry is the sentence finished."
Where the brush passes, even resistance is struck through.
Each melee hit cuts {value|%s} s off {resist|Apoptosis Resist}
On burst the target is {fear|feared} for {value|%s} s: it cannot move or attack
Use {value|/summyapocrypha fear players on} to make {fear|fear} affect players
item.summy-reliquary-apocrypha.final_son: "When the song ends, the corpse is still warm."
Sung to the last note, even the wound opens and closes in time.
While {state|Injured} the target takes {value|%s%} of this {burst|burst} as {element|elemental damage} every second
command.summy-reliquary-apocrypha.fear.p: Apoptosis fear now affects players (movement, melee and right-click are locked)
